lw_lampwright_hammer.name: Lampwright's Peening Hammer
lw_lampwright_hammer.desc: A lampwright's peening hammer, worn to the shape of a hand.

lw_apron.name: Lampwright's Apron
lw_apron.desc: A smith's leather apron, scorched and mended and scorched again.

lw_pit_lamp.name: Corm's Pit-Lamp
lw_pit_lamp.desc: Corm's own pit-lamp, lent and never missed. Its flame was never lit; it just does not go out.

lw_lamp_blank.name: Lamp Blank
lw_lamp_blank.desc: An unfinished lamp, glass and brass, waiting for a wick.

lw_receipt.name: Receipt: the Lampwrights' Deep
lw_receipt.desc: Received of the Lampwrights, Corm's pit-lamp, and a copy (a copy, not the book) of his notes on the quench. He asked what I intend. I said: nothing anyone need pay for. He did not believe me. He lent it anyway. Held in trust. -A.

lw_quench_notes.name: Corm's Notes on the Quench
lw_quench_notes.desc: Two quenches I know: water for the heat, oil for the brittle. A third was in the book Aldric took, and he copied it back to me wrong, or I read it wrong. It said the third wants fire, and not any fire. I have tried every fire in the Deep. They all take the edge off. -Corm.
